lead_raw_text:
The structure of YbCdTe crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms—Yb4 Cd4 Te4—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis (CrystalNN) shows Cd and Te each coordinated by eight neighbors (4 Cd/4 Te for Cd, 4 Cd/4 Yb for Te), while Yb is surrounded by 16 neighbors (8 Cd and 8 Te). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Cd and Te 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Yb 16-vertex polyhedra.
